We have several atolls that are facing the same difficulties like Tuvalu,.  There are only some scientists staying on them and some as five star ultras expensivetourist resorts. One island is  protected as UNESCO world heritage site, with over 100,000 giants land tortoises. Those that want to see footage of this wonderful atoll google Aldabra Island Seychelles on YouTube,  there you will find the beauty of this island, flamingos, giant coconut crabs, a flightless bird, dugong and thousands of sea creatures and sea birds.
